transcript.text: Alright, let's get this change review started for the Monday customer data import. We've got the scheduled window from 2:00 AM to 8:00 AM and the runbook estimates a 60-node compute pool will complete within that window. Before I finalize the operating plan, I need to hear from both of you: on-call reliability engineer, do you have any final operational concerns about the 60-node pool or the import window? And customer success lead, any concerns from the customer side regarding timing or impact? Once I've heard from both of you, I'll settle the plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a final operational concern. During an unrelated overnight load test, I measured memory fragmentation in the import workers and confirmed that the job needs a 72-node compute pool to remain within its safe utilization limit. I only confirmed this result minutes ago, so the runbook hasn't been updated yet to reflect the 72-node requirement.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a final customer-side concern. I confirmed with the account team this morning that the customer's contract requires the import to be fully completed by Monday at 6:00 AM and does not permit a staged partial delivery. I haven't added this requirement to the operations ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the runbook to reflect the confirmed 72-node compute pool requirement based on the memory fragmentation findings.
Update the operations ticket to record the customer contract requirement that the import must be fully completed by Monday 6:00 AM with no staged partial delivery.
